name: Shenzhen hongfuhan Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen hongfuhan Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of heat dissipation, automation equipment, and other functional devices. The company offers die-cutting, metal stamping, injection molding, and die-casting products, as well as thermal solutions. Its consumer electronic products and components are used in smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart wearables, and home smart devices.
